findings.explanation: Rogers can end the contract without cause at any time, but you do not have a matching right to walk away. Since work done is paid, this creates a minor imbalance.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time upon sixty (60) days' prior written notice to the other party.
